name: SkillTracer: Structural Failure Attribution and Refinement of Agentic Skills in Long-Horizon Web Tasks
notes: The framework combines short-term traces with historical evidence in a persistent skill graph. The authors report a 17.7% average success-rate improvement over baselines and gains up to 56.3% in cross-domain settings.
summary: SkillTracer maps web agent skills to inspectable plan graphs, uses interaction traces to locate failures, and refines reusable skills across long tasks and episodes.
